                return False

                    (expense_id,)

                db.commit()
                return True
            else:
                db.rollback()
                return False
        except (psycopg.errors.SerializationFailure, psycopg.errors.DeadlockDetected):
            db.rollback()
            continue
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise

                "SELECT department_id, status FROM expenses WHERE id = %s",
                (expense_id,)

                (dept_id,)
